top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a clean mechanism-level prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) that was tested sharply by the 2018 discovery of correlated and superconducting states at that angle, and the phenomenology has since been reproduced across many laboratories and moire platforms; the narrow citation avoids claiming the pairing mechanism. P002 is the cleanest attribution and fully mature but a refinement of a quantity already measurable, so it ranks second; no award ranks last because two mature, well-attributed candidates exist.
